candidate_decisions.reason: The five nominated branches meet the activation test within the declared pericope: the focus وَهَبْنَا branch supplies a water-holding rock cavity, while 19:43, 19:47, 19:55, and 19:58 supply independent hollow, abundance, and basin contacts. Together they materially reframe gift as bounded provision while retaining the ordinary giving sense.

All eight nominated branches have supplied carriers in 19:43 or the focus and independent guidance, following, road, and prophetic contacts in 19:41, 19:49, 19:51, and 19:58. Their contact materially makes the focus designation legible as a marked route without displacing its ordinary prophetic sense.

All six nominated branches have supplied carriers across the pericope or focus, and the call, confidential speech, tongue, writing, message, and light-sound contacts form a materially changed relay reading. The focus sound facets remain qualified by the packet boundary.

The exact HFT trace supplies the withdrawal, gift, mercy, kin, and prophetic-office coordinates in 19:49, 19:50, and 19:53 and returns through focus words. The legacy_unbound status qualifies the inferred restorative pattern but does not suppress its fully anchored attributed evidence.

The exact HFT trace names Moses's consecration and messenger role in 19:51, confidential nearness in 19:52, and the focus brother-prophet, with every role returning through a focus occurrence. The inferred movement from private reception to relay remains attributed and qualified.

The exact HFT trace supplies the paternal exchange, hearing, guidance, commanded severance, and enacted withdrawal at 19:42, 19:43, 19:46, and 19:48, then returns through the focus mercy, brotherhood, and prophetic-news occurrences. The contrastive kinship inference survives as attributed evidence, with the supplied weak neighbor assessment retained as qualification.

The exact HFT trace joins the singular focus gift and brotherhood to the closing 19:58 class of favored, guided, selected, responsive prophets. Every listed role has a supplied coordinate and a focus return; its network inference remains attributed.

The exact HFT outlier supplies the 19:43 guidance-road sequence and returns it through the focus gift, brotherhood, and clear-road facet of prophetic designation. The person-as-path image is retained as exploratory attributed evidence with its ordinary-sense boundary explicit.

The exact HFT outlier supplies the mountain carrier in 19:52 and the focus water-retaining, mercy, brotherhood, and news contacts in 19:53. The material basin analogy survives only as exploratory attributed evidence and does not invent a contextual water gloss for the ordinary verb.

findings.title: Gift as a bounded water reservoir
findings.claim: Within the native pericope, the focus gift can be locally pictured as provision gathered and held in a rock basin, with later abundance and selection making that provision accessible.
findings.mechanism: The focus وَهَبْنَا carrier has an exact water-retaining rock-cavity facet; it meets the water-gathering hollow in 19:43, abundant water around رَبّ in 19:47 and 19:55, and the collected basin in 19:58. The repeated gift pattern supplies the provision relation that lets these otherwise separate water images explain one another.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the gift as both a bestowed person and a bounded source of provision, so giving acquires an image of holding and access.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that Aaron is given to Moses from divine mercy. The reservoir is a local contextual image, not a claim that the verse literally names water or that every gift is hydrology; the 19:47 reciprocal counterevidence keeps a bare mercy mention from being treated as sufficient proof.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted, while the material reservoir synthesis combines several nominated cross-root images and therefore remains a qualified interpretation.

findings.title: Prophecy as a marked route
findings.claim: The pericope's guidance, following, waymark, leading-edge, and straight-road images meet the focus designation of Aaron as a clear road, making prophecy locally legible as a route that is marked and can be followed.
findings.mechanism: 19:43 supplies knowledge becoming clear, a guide's direction, following, and a straight road; the surrounding prophetic occurrences in 19:41, 19:49, 19:51, and 19:58 supply repeated prophetic carriers. The focus clear-road facet contacts that sequence and turns a person designation into a contained navigational image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prophetic designation as more than an office label: it can also organize a local picture of guidance, signs, and movement toward a destination.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading of نَبِيًّا as prophet remains primary. The route image is a pericope-bounded resonance, not a claim that prophecy is literally a road, not a surah-wide thesis, and not a ranking of the focus's other live branches.

epistemic.reason: The channel support directly supplies the guidance, following, waymark, and road contacts and the focus branch has an exact clear-road facet; the inference remains bounded to this pericope.

The contact shifts the focus from an isolated office label to a message whose reach survives changes in vocal intensity and audience.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see a communicative chain in which a message is called, concentrated, carried, and delivered, while the ordinary prophetic meaning remains recoverable.
findings.containment: The focus still identifies Aaron as a prophet. The relay is a trusted pericope-local resonance, not a claim that the focus word literally means a whisper, not a whole-surah thesis, and not a claim that every written or spoken contact is equally active.

epistemic.reason: The channel supports directly nominate the call, confidential speech, message, tongue, and writing contacts, while the focus sound specialization adds a bounded interpretive step.

findings.title: Mercy renews mission through kin
findings.claim: The focus's brother-prophet is locally legible as a new instance of the pericope's pattern in which divine gift and mercy renew a mission-bearing relation after withdrawal.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT trace places withdrawal and gifted prophetic kin in 19:49, repeats gift from mercy in 19:50, and recombines gift, mercy, brotherhood, and prophetic office in 19:53. The repeated construction contacts the focus's kin and prophet carriers and changes an isolated favor into a possible restoration of mission through relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see Aaron's arrival against a concrete sequence of separation followed by renewed, mission-bearing kinship.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains a divine gift of Aaron as a prophet. The restorative arrow is an attributed HFT inference; the repeated formulas may also function as a catalogue of cumulative honors, and neither reading is suppressed.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is exact in pericope scope and complete in anchor coordinates but legacy_unbound, so the semantic movement is retained as attributed contextual evidence rather than independently established lexicon.

The exact HFT trace connects those positions and returns through the focus occurrences.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the focus as a change in the shape of mission: privileged reception is followed by a relation capable of carrying the message outward.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that Aaron is an additional prophet and brother given to Moses. The relay is an attributed contextual inference; the sequence may also be cumulative honor without a transfer of communicative burden.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is exact and fully anchored in 19:51-53, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and its semantic movement is therefore attributed.
